title: Assertion: Fair Arbiter Grants
constraints: Rule 1: `gnt` is one-hot or zero. Rule 2: only requesting masters are granted (`gnt & ~req == 0`).
Rule 3 (fairness): a master granted in one cycle must not be granted again in the next cycle if any **other** master is requesting in that next cycle.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Fairness per master i: `$past(gnt[i]) && (req & ~(4'b1 << i)) != 0 |-> !gnt[i]`. A `generate for` loop creates one assertion per master.

examples.check: violation: back-to-back grant while others wait
examples.title: unfair
examples.input: master 0 granted twice in a row, master 2 waiting
